projectDescription: An Android app that scans, maps, and visualizes all active Wi-Fi signals in the 2.4 GHz band across four real-time views: network list, channel map, time graph, and statistics.
keyFeatures: Real-time Wi-Fi scanning of the 2.4 GHz band (channels 1–13, 2412–2472 MHz)
Network list view with SSID, BSSID, RSSI (dBm), signal percentage, channel, and security label
Channel map showing per-channel saturation level and all detected networks per channel
Time graph plotting RSSI history per BSSID across up to 20 scan cycles with sliding 10-point window
Statistics view with signal-quality distribution, channel usage histogram, and security-type breakdown
Automatic 5-second scan refresh on the Time Graph tab
30-second scan cooldown with graceful fallback to cached results
Runtime permission handling for ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, and NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES (Android 13+)
Security classification: WPA3, WPA2, WPA, WEP, OWE, and Open detection from raw capabilities string
Prime channel highlighting for non-overlapping channels 1, 6, and 11
publicApiSurface: ScannedNetwork(ssid, bssid, rssi, signalPercent, frequency, channel, capabilities)
ScannedNetwork.getSecurityLabel() — derives WPA3/WPA2/WPA/WEP/OWE/Open label from capabilities
WifiChannel.getNetworks() — list of ScannedNetwork objects detected on this channel
StatisticsGraphView.updateData(int[] qualityCounts, int[] channelCounts, Map<String,Integer> securityCounts)
SCAN_COOLDOWN_MS = 30 000 ms, SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS = 12 000 ms, FREQ_MIN = 2410 MHz, FREQ_MAX = 2486 MHz
